comparison.objective: Rotate a suspended humanoid upper body and, in one version, fit its back cover.
comparison.physical_skill: Control rotational inertia of a hanging load, stop it accurately, and optionally align and seat a cover.
comparison.success_condition: Body stopped at the target heading or cover seated while still, without blows or uncontrolled collision.
comparison.reason: Suspended-load yaw control and cover placement do not test aperture passage, recovery yield, or retained-workpiece preservation.
